title: fragaria collina var. soyeriana
intro: Fragaria collina var. soyeriana, commonly known as the Soyer's strawberry or Soyer strawberry, is a variety of strawberry plant native to Europe. It is a perennial herb that has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Fragaria collina var. soyeriana include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems due to its expectorant properties. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
